title: FiduciaLocks
description: Canonical request and operation-output payloads for union locks, counting semaphores, file leases, and reader-writer locks.

LockAcquireRequest.title: LockAcquireRequest
LockAcquireRequest.description: Body of POST /v1/locks/acquire. Supply key or keys; when both are present, keys takes precedence.

key.description: One slash-safe member key. Use keys for an atomic union.

keys.description: Keys acquired atomically as one canonicalized union. The server sorts and deduplicates them.

holder.description: Required, non-empty caller-chosen holder identity. Reuse it for retry, renew, release, and cancel.

request_id.description: Optional caller-generated identity for this logical acquisition attempt. Generate it with cryptographically strong randomness, reuse it for every retry and the matching cancel, and never reuse it for a later attempt.

ttl_ms.description: Held-lease TTL in milliseconds; defaults to 30000.

wait.description: When true, enqueue durably if the union cannot be granted immediately; defaults to false.

wait_timeout_ms.description: Independent lifetime of a wait:true queue entry; defaults to 30000. Retries do not extend the original deadline.

LockAcquireManyRequest.title: LockAcquireManyRequest
LockAcquireManyRequest.description: Typed multi-key subset of POST /v1/locks/acquire. Acquires a bounded union atomically; use LockAcquireRequest when key-or-keys flexibility is needed.

keys.description: Keys to lock as one union. The server sorts/dedupes before acquisition.

request_id.description: Optional caller-generated identity for this logical acquisition attempt. Reuse it across retries and cancellation; a new logical attempt must use a new value.

ttl_ms.description: Held-lease TTL in milliseconds; defaults to 30000.

wait.description: When true, enqueue durably if the union cannot be granted immediately; defaults to false.

wait_timeout_ms.description: Independent lifetime of a wait:true queue entry; defaults to 30000.

LockHolder.title: LockHolder
LockHolder.description: One active union-lock grant. lock_id and exclusive are deprecated compatibility fields and are not emitted by the current node API.

lock_id.description: Deprecated legacy identifier; current grants are authorized by holder plus fencing_token.

exclusive.description: Deprecated legacy field; union locks are always exclusive and current responses omit it.

LockPromotedGrant.title: LockPromotedGrant
LockPromotedGrant.description: A queued union-lock request promoted by the same committed release or cancel operation.

SemaphorePromotedGrant.title: SemaphorePromotedGrant
SemaphorePromotedGrant.description: A queued semaphore holder promoted by the same committed release or cancel operation.

LockAcquireResponse.title: LockAcquireResponse
LockAcquireResponse.description: Exact operation output of POST /v1/locks/acquire, inside the node propose envelope. Authority fields are present only when acquired is true; queue fields describe a durable waiter when queued is true.

renewed.description: False on an idempotent same-holder/key-set retry, making explicit that acquire did not extend the lease; absent on a new grant or failed acquire.

fencing_token.description: Present only for a live grant. The canonical JSON wire range is capped at JavaScript's maximum safe integer so browser clients never silently round authority.

lease_expires_ms.description: Present only for a live grant.

position.description: One-based queue position when queued is true; explicit null on an unqueued failed try-lock.

wait_expires_ms.description: Absolute replicated queue deadline when queued is true; explicit null on an unqueued failed try-lock.

conflicts.description: Requested member keys currently held by another grant.

LockGrant.title: LockGrant
LockGrant.description: Deprecated compatibility shape from the pre-union lock API. Current consumers must use LockAcquireResponse or the dedicated semaphore/RW response type.

lock_id.description: Deprecated legacy id; never emitted by current union-lock endpoints.

fencing_token.description: Monotonic token to fence stale holders; set when acquired.

fencing_tokens.description: Deprecated legacy per-key tokens; current union grants have one fencing_token for the complete key set.

keys.description: Composite keys when this is a multi-key grant.

holders.description: Deprecated legacy semaphore count; use SemaphoreAcquireResponse.

max.description: Deprecated legacy semaphore limit; use SemaphoreAcquireResponse.limit.

available.description: Deprecated legacy semaphore capacity; use SemaphoreAcquireResponse.available.

LockRenewRequest.title: LockRenewRequest
LockRenewRequest.description: Token-bound body of POST /v1/locks/renew. Supply the exact key set and holder from the grant.

ttl_ms.description: Renewal TTL measured from the committed command time; defaults to 30000.

LockRenewResponse.title: LockRenewResponse
LockRenewResponse.description: Exact operation output of POST /v1/locks/renew. Grant fields are present only when renewed is true.

reason.description: Stable failure reason when renewed is false.

holder.description: The holder identity used at acquire.

reason.description: Stable failure reason when released is false.

keys.description: Released union when released is true.

promoted.description: Waiters promoted by the same committed release.

LockReleaseManyRequest.title: LockReleaseManyRequest
LockReleaseManyRequest.description: Deprecated request for the removed POST /v1/locks/release-many route. Current union grants are released with LockReleaseRequest.

lock_id.description: Deprecated composite id; current endpoints do not emit lock_id.

LockCancelRequest.title: LockCancelRequest
LockCancelRequest.description: Body of idempotent POST /v1/locks/cancel. Identifies one exact queued holder/key-set request; it never silently releases an active grant.

request_id.description: Attempt identity from the acquire being cancelled. When present, cancellation is durable and suppresses only that exact late acquire; omitting it preserves the legacy holder/key cancellation behavior.

LockCancelResponse.title: LockCancelResponse
LockCancelResponse.description: Exact operation output of POST /v1/locks/cancel. If cancellation races promotion, acquired is true and authority fields let the aborting client release safely.

reason.description: Present when cancellation did not establish safety. cancellation_capacity means the bounded replicated tombstone table was full; callers must surface failure and must not assume the ambiguous acquire was suppressed.

fencing_token.description: Present when acquired is true after a promotion race.

lease_expires_ms.description: Present when acquired is true after a promotion race.

request_id.description: Optional caller-generated identity for this logical permit-acquisition attempt. Reuse it across retries and cancellation; a new logical attempt must use a new value.

limit.description: Maximum concurrent holders. It becomes immutable when the semaphore is first created; later mismatches fail without changing capacity.

wait.description: When true, enqueue durably when capacity is unavailable; defaults to false.

wait_timeout_ms.description: Independent lifetime of a wait:true queue entry; defaults to 30000.

renewed.description: False on an idempotent same-holder retry, making explicit that acquire did not extend the permit; absent otherwise.

reason.description: Present only when an existing semaphore has a different immutable limit.

requested_limit.description: Rejected caller-provided limit when reason is limit_mismatch.

available.description: Current free permits; absent from a limit_mismatch response.

fencing_token.description: Present only for a live permit. The canonical JSON wire range is capped at JavaScript's maximum safe integer so browser clients never silently round authority.

lease_expires_ms.description: Present only for a live permit.

position.description: One-based queue position when queued; explicit null on an unqueued failed try-acquire.

wait_expires_ms.description: Absolute replicated queue deadline when queued; explicit null on an unqueued failed try-acquire.

ttl_ms.description: Renewal TTL measured from the committed command time; defaults to 30000.

SemaphoreCancelRequest.title: SemaphoreCancelRequest
SemaphoreCancelRequest.description: Body of idempotent POST /v1/semaphores/cancel for one exact key/holder queue identity.

request_id.description: Attempt identity from the acquire being cancelled. When present, cancellation is durable and scoped to that exact attempt; omitting it preserves legacy behavior.

SemaphoreCancelResponse.title: SemaphoreCancelResponse
SemaphoreCancelResponse.description: Exact operation output of POST /v1/semaphores/cancel. A promotion race returns acquired:true with authority fields so the client can release safely.

reason.description: cancellation_capacity means no durable attempt tombstone was installed; callers must surface failure.

fencing_token.description: Present when acquired is true after a promotion race.

lease_expires_ms.description: Present when acquired is true after a promotion race.

FileLeaseAcquireRequest.title: FileLeaseAcquireRequest
FileLeaseAcquireRequest.description: Bridge-to-control-plane request to atomically lease repository-relative file paths.

repository.description: Canonical GitHub owner/repo identity. A legacy bare repo may be accepted only by a server migration path and must not be emitted by new clients.

paths.description: Repository-relative paths. Absolute paths, traversal, backslashes, and empty components are rejected.

FileLeaseReleaseRequest.title: FileLeaseReleaseRequest
FileLeaseReleaseRequest.description: Bridge-to-control-plane request to release a file-path union lease.

FileLeaseRenewRequest.title: FileLeaseRenewRequest
FileLeaseRenewRequest.description: Bridge-to-control-plane request to renew one exact repository-path union lease without changing its fencing token.

paths.description: The complete canonical repository-relative path set from the acquired union lease.

FileLeaseQuery.title: FileLeaseQuery
FileLeaseQuery.description: Query parameters used to find the bot or agent holding a repository file lease.

repository.description: Canonical GitHub owner/repo identity. Legacy bare values are migration input only.
